title: From Generative AI to Agent
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: A vis-network chain of four terms (Generative AI, Large Language Model, AI Assistant, AI Agent) joined by three links. For each link, in order, the learner chooses which of four options the second term adds to the first, commits once, and receives feedback on the choice plus the correct option. The final score is reported as n of 3 correct, and mastery is 3 of 3.

learningObjectives: Explain what capability each of the three links in the chain from generative AI to AI agent adds, by selecting the correct capability for all three links
Distinguish an AI agent from an AI assistant by the addition of tools and a loop: the agent acts, observes the result, and chooses the next step

accessibility.notes: The graph has an aria-label listing the four nodes in order, and the same four nodes appear as keyboard-reachable buttons. Options are native radio inputs (arrow keys to move, Enter to commit). Answered links carry a check-mark or X glyph and text status, not color alone; colors are from the Okabe-Ito blue/orange palette. Mouse-wheel zoom and drag-to-pan are disabled so the iframe never captures page scrolling.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict-then-reveal concept chain: the learner commits a choice for what each link adds before the correct capability and a misconception-specific explanation are shown
keyQuestions: What changes at each step from generative AI to an AI agent?
What does the second term add to the first?
commonMisconceptions: An assistant and an agent are the same thing with different branding
A larger model is what turns an assistant into an agent
An agent is simply a chatbot with a friendlier tone or a longer memory
assessmentOpportunities: Score on the first commit for each of the three links; mastery is 3 of 3 correct
Restart with reshuffled option order and answer all three links without opening the node definitions
Write one sentence explaining the difference between an AI assistant and an AI agent

controls.name: Open a node
controls.purpose: Show the definition of Generative AI, Large Language Model, AI Assistant, or AI Agent (exploration, not scored)

controls.name: Options
controls.purpose: Choose one of four capabilities for the current link; order is shuffled per run

controls.name: Commit answer
controls.purpose: Lock the chosen option for the current link and show feedback; one commit per link

controls.name: Next link
controls.purpose: Advance to the next link after the current link has been answered

controls.name: Restart
controls.purpose: Clear all answers and reshuffle the option order
